description: This is a Java test source file that contains abstract test cases for the Credentials API within the Eclipse Hono project. It verifies various behaviors such as retrieving credentials, handling non-existing or disabled credentials, and context-based credential retrieval.

classes.name: CredentialsApiTests
classes.description: An abstract class providing common test cases for the Credentials API in the Eclipse Hono project. It includes tests for credential retrieval, error handling for non-existent or disabled credentials, and context-based credential access.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain a client for interacting with the Credentials service, scoped to a specific tenant.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsFailsForNonExistingAuthId
methods.description: Test to verify that requesting credentials for a non-existing authentication ID returns a 404 error.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsByTypeAndAuthId
methods.description: Test to verify successful retrieval of credentials by type and auth ID, including verification of default properties.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsFailsForDisabledCredentials
methods.description: Test to ensure that request for disabled credentials fails with a 404 error.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsByClientContext
methods.description: Disabled test intended to verify credentials retrieval with a specific client context.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsFailsForNonMatchingClientContext
methods.description: Disabled test verifying failure when the client context does not match credentials.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsFailsForNonExistingClientContext
methods.description: Test that requesting credentials with a non-existing client context results in a 404 error.

methods.name: getRandomHashedPasswordCredentials
methods.description: Utility method to generate a collection with a single random hashed password credential.

methods.name: getRandomHashedPasswordCredential
methods.description: Utility method to create a single hashed password credential with predefined secrets and validity periods.

methods.name: assertStandardProperties
methods.description: Helper method to verify standard properties of retrieved CredentialsObject, such as enabled status, device ID, auth ID, type, and secrets count.
